Sure thing! If you just want to see the current time right from the command prompt, you can run one of these:

```cmd
:: 1️⃣  Simple CMD way (shows time in HH:MM:SS.mmm format)
echo %time%
```

```powershell
:: 2️⃣  PowerShell way (gives a full DateTime object)
powershell -Command Get-Date
```

Just paste the line you prefer into your Command Prompt (or PowerShell) window and hit **Enter**.  
That will print the current system time for you.
